grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or an accepted staple, such as tinned tomatoes, stock, bread and fennel seeds.

supermarket.reason: Pollock, mushrooms, oranges and the rest are everyday Tesco items at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only one large pan and simple frying and simmering.

works.reason: A litre of stock, a tin of tomatoes, 400g potatoes and 400g pollock make a sensible soup for four, and the timings will cook both the potatoes and the fish.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers the chopping, zesting and the short frying, and the remaining simmering roughly matches the 25 minutes printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, nothing unlisted is used, and the names match their ids.

seasonal_feel.reason: The title leads with pollock and the 250g of mushrooms are one element among potatoes, tomatoes, orange and fish, so on a mushroom day this reads as a fish soup rather than a dish built around mushrooms.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling soup of fish, potatoes and vegetables with bread, a proper family lunch.
